name: Tear Ticket
description: Perforated ticket card with a draggable stub. Grab the stub and pull to tear it off along the perforation with stretching fibres, physics drop and fade, plus a pointer-driven 3D tilt on the ticket.
contents: Ticket body with optional cover image, scrim and children slot
Tear-off stub with its own children slot
Perforation line of holes with stretching paper fibres
Optional outline border on body and stub
behavior: Dragging the stub pivots it around a hinge at the nearest end of the perforation, bridges stretch and snap one by one
Once fully torn, releasing drops the stub with gravity, spin and fade, then calls onTear and marks the ticket used
Releasing early springs the stub back
Used ticket greys the image, dims content and optionally recenters the body
Ticket tilts in 3D toward the pointer with image and content parallax, paused while dragging
Keyboard Enter or Space tears instantly; with reduced motion a drag over 28px tears instantly and tilt is off
Scales down to fit narrower containers
Can be controlled via torn or uncontrolled via defaultTorn
editableByProps: Body and stub content, cover image, scrim and image radius
Horizontal or vertical layout, size, stub size and corner radius
Perforation hole count, size, notch and roughness
Tear feel: angle, stretch distance, resistance
Tilt, parallax, perspective and resting rotation
Controlled or uncontrolled torn state, onTear callback, disabled state, aria label

needsCodeEdit.change: Change fall speed of the torn stub
Change image area height relative to the body
Change how fast snapped fibres retract

needsCodeEdit.where: role="status" span at the end of the JSX

fixed: Requires the motion package (motion/react) and Tailwind CSS
Adds a window pointermove listener for tilt while mounted
Uses a ResizeObserver and scales the ticket down to fit narrower parents, never up
Stub is pinned with touch-none and only primary button drags
Perforation and tear fibres are drawn with clip-path path() shapes, tear fibre color follows background
Torn stub is hidden after tearing, no built-in reset control, reset by changing torn or defaultTorn state

options.look: Stub on the right, torn sideways along a vertical perforation
options.useWhen: Classic wide event or cinema ticket

options.look: Stub at the bottom, torn downward along a horizontal perforation
options.useWhen: Tall coupon or boarding pass style card
